rw0-baseline.title: Baseline: capture rework OIDs, EOL, and the pre-existing tracked dirt
rw0-baseline.imperative: Capture HEAD tree OID and the blob OIDs of every file f6acc1e touched, derive EOL per base (#319), and record the Commander's OWN pre-existing tracked dirt (.agent-work/issue-305/execute.json + .journal) so my restoration check does not falsely claim or falsely absolve it.

rw1-scope.imperative: Verify f6acc1e touches exactly docs/CHECKLIST_ENGINE_DESIGN.md and scripts/context_manifest.py, that no test/assertion/behaviour changed, and that nothing from claims 1-4 was re-opened.

rw2-atoms.title: (a) ATTACK the replacement causal clause atom by atom
rw2-atoms.imperative: The replacement is the SAME SHAPE of claim that just failed. Independently verify each atom: g1-review.json really was added first; it really reports true; commit 2456130 really cleaned the tree; the interval really is 2m16s; and the eight-minute gap. rw3-instrument.imperative: Apply to the Commander's use of --diff-filter=A the same skepticism I applied to --follow. Check for multiple A entries (add/delete/re-add), check commit-order vs file-write-order, and cross-check against an independent witness (run.generated_at inside the files). Rule on whether 'the second manifest added to that context directory' is the right framing.

rw4-pin.imperative: Measure the manifest counts at several revisions and determine whether ANY commit reproduces 49/47/1/1. If none does, the pin names an instant the tree cannot reproduce and the decay is relocated, not stopped. Rule on severity.

rw5-docstring-only.title: (d) Re-derive that context_manifest.py is still docstring-only
rw5-docstring-only.imperative: Re-derive with my OWN instrument (optimize=2 bytecode code-object compare + positional docstring-span containment), NOT the Commander's ast.dump-stripped compare, that scripts/context_manifest.py at f6acc1e is behaviourally identical to f6acc1e^.

rw6-sweep.title: (e) Check the Commander's sweep
rw6-sweep.imperative: Independently sweep shipped dirs for any surviving copy of the false causal claim ('run's first', 'no predecessor'), the forbidden permanence claim, run.dirty, and the stale present-tense form of the measurement. rw7-suite.title: Full suite still green on the reworked tree
rw7-suite.imperative: Run python -m pytest tests/ -q (NEVER py) against the reworked tree and compare to my 1487 / 2 / 472 baseline.

rw8-fowler.title: Refactoring pass (Fowler) on the rework diff
rw8-fowler.imperative: Run the Fowler baseline pass over the rework diff, record it, and run verify_fowler_pass.py until it exits 0.

rw9-restore.title: Terminal: tree restored, nothing committed
rw9-restore.imperative: Confirm every blob I could have touched matches its rework baseline and that the Commander's pre-existing dirt is neither worsened nor silently absolved.
